title: hero section part 2
audio: Not used: the hero plays extracted still frames, so no audio is shipped.
usage: Illustrative cinematic homepage background; does not depict a Rathore Group project.

extraction.method: Decoded in Chrome (Playwright) and encoded with sharp; no intermediate lossy step
extraction.mobileCrop: centre 9:16 crop of the 1080p frame, scaled to 1080×1920
extraction.note: Source is 1080p, so the 1440p/4K tiers are omitted rather than upscaled. Desktop frames at q68 (detailed footage: ~36 MB).
extraction.cutDissolves: Hard scene cuts eased into cross-dissolves (qa/sequence/dissolve-cuts.mjs): desktop frames 42/72/108/143 over 12 frames, mobile 28/48/72/96 over 8.
